source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the synapse (PDF 33).

blocks.text: Ek neuron ke axon terminal aur doosre neurons ke dendrites, ya effector cells (muscle ya gland ke cells), ke jor ko synapse kehte hain. Synapse par do neurons, ya ek neuron aur ek cell, aapas mein seedha nahin chhoote. Balke un ke darmiyan maya (fluid) se bhari ek khaali jagah hoti hai jise synaptic cleft kehte hain. Jis neuron ka axon action potentials ko synapse ki taraf bhejta hai woh presynaptic neuron hai. Synapse ki doosri taraf wala neuron ya cell postsynaptic cell hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Motor neuron aur muscle fibre ke darmiyan synapse ko neuro-muscular junction bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Synapse par presynaptic aur postsynaptic cells ko kya alag rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Synaptic cleft, yaani maya (fluid) se bhari tang khaali jagah.

items: Synapse: presynaptic neuron aur postsynaptic cell ka jor; darmiyan maya se bhara synaptic cleft hai. Motor neuron aur muscle fibre ka synapse neuro-muscular junction hai.
